title: Rebrand: VSI is now Krans
brief: Announce the new name and website. Ten variants across the four brand grounds, three product windows and one team photo, each with a ready LinkedIn caption. Assumes the previous name was VSI: confirm before posting.

posts.label: New name
posts.title: VSI is now *Krans.*
posts.caption:
VSI has a new name: Krans.

Same product, now with its own home at krans.ai. Krans turns everything your ventures already produce into positions you can check: where each venture stands, and the evidence behind it.

krans.ai

posts.label: krans.ai
posts.title: Evidence-based venture intelligence.
posts.caption:
Krans is evidence-based venture intelligence.

Customer calls, internal meetings, Slack threads, documents, pipeline numbers: your ventures already produce more than anyone can read. Krans models each venture, and every signal moves it.

krans.ai

posts.label: Portfolio
posts.title: Where each venture stands, and what it needs next.
posts.caption:
Monday morning, you know which venture needs you, and why.

Krans gives every venture a clear read each morning: how far along it really is, how strong the evidence behind it is, and what is missing before the next gate. Nobody updates anything by hand.

krans.ai

posts.label: How Krans weighs a claim
posts.title: From vague, to they put something at stake.
posts.caption:
Not every learning weighs the same.

Krans grades each one on an evidence scale, from E0 (vague) to E5 (they put something at stake), and cites who said it and when. Conviction stops being a feeling and becomes something you can audit.

krans.ai

posts.label: Krans
posts.title: Instinct starts ventures. *Evidence compounds them.*
posts.caption:
Instinct starts ventures. Evidence compounds them.

Krans is the new name for the venture intelligence we have been running on every venture. Now at krans.ai.

krans.ai

posts.label: Influx
posts.title: Everything your ventures already produce.
posts.caption:
Krans reads what your ventures already produce: calls from Google Meet, Teams, Granola or Read.ai, and documents from Notion and Google Drive.

Each input becomes its smallest defensible unit, a passage in someone's own words, pinned to who said it and when. Nobody writes a summary.

krans.ai

posts.label: Days
posts.title: A claim nobody repeats loses its weight.
posts.caption:
Evidence ages.

In Krans, a claim nobody has repeated for sixty days loses weight, along with the positions built on it. Confidence fades wherever nothing new confirms it, so the model is never out of date.

krans.ai

posts.label: Tonight's run
posts.title: Nobody updates anything by hand.
posts.caption:
While you sleep, Krans reads the day.

Every call, thread and document lands against the part of the model it touches, and each morning you get a clear read of every venture, every relationship and every call.

krans.ai

posts.label: Signals
posts.title: One buyer saying it is noise. *Five buyers saying it is a signal.*
posts.caption:
One buyer saying it is noise. Five buyers saying it is a signal.

In Krans, a signal hardens when the same thing keeps coming up across a venture's calls and threads, and fades again when nobody repeats it.

krans.ai

posts.label: Built inside Builders
posts.title: A decade of ventures, *now a product.*
posts.caption:
Krans is built on learnings from a decade of ventures built inside Builders.

It started as the system we used to see where every venture really stands. Today it has a new name and its own home, for venture studios, corporate venture builders and funds that run more ventures than anyone can sit in calls for.

krans.ai
